protocol:
1. A liquid is transferred using a single-channel pipette into microcentrifuge tubes held in a pink 96-well rack.
2. Using a single-channel pipette, liquid is transferred from the tubes in the pink rack to tubes in a purple 96-well rack.
3. Liquid is transferred from a blue 96-well plate to the tubes in the pink 96-well rack using a single-channel pipette.
4. A bacterial colony is picked from the surface of an agar plate using a sterile pipette tip.
5. The picked colony is transferred into a microcentrifuge tube containing liquid in the pink 96-well rack.
6. The colony is resuspended in the liquid by pipetting up and down with a single-channel pipette.
7. Liquid is transferred from a tube in the purple rack to a well in a lime green 96-well plate using a single-channel pipette.
8. A liquid is transferred into multiple wells of the lime green 96-well plate using a multi-channel pipette.
9. The GoPro camera recording the experiment is turned off after 5 minutes and 50 seconds.
